title: CT Multiphase Liver

source.organisation: Oregon Health & Science University (OHSU), Diagnostic Radiology

indication: Evaluation and characterization of focal liver lesions

topogram.coverage_text: Above the dome of liver to iliac crest

timing.roi_text: Put tracker Mid-Pancreas on the Descending Aorta.
timing.level_text: Bolus tracker Mid-Liver in Descending Aorta.

review_checks: Review the non-contrast scan to ensure all of the liver is included.
Check that the tracker sits on the descending aorta.
notes: The sheet gives 4.0 or 5.0 mL/s for the injection; its scan instructions for this variant use 4 mL/s, which is the value used here.
The sheet text says the tracker goes 'Mid-Pancreas' in the summary and 'Mid-Liver' in the scan instructions; both are kept as quotes. The tracker is placed in the descending aorta either way.

quotes.positioning.arms: Top to Bottom Dual Scout (with arms up)
quotes.topogram.coverage_text: Above the dome of liver to iliac crest
quotes.indication: Evaluation and characterization of focal liver lesions
quotes.contrast.timing.method: Bolus Tracked: Trigger Scan from HU.
quotes.contrast.timing.roi_text: Put tracker Mid-Pancreas on the Descending Aorta.
quotes.contrast.timing.level_text: Bolus tracker Mid-Liver in Descending Aorta.
quotes.series.noncontrast.coverage_text: NON-CONTRAST Diaphragm to Iliac Crest (Blue box)
quotes.series.venous.timing: VENOUS delay 55 seconds after bolus tracker.
quotes.series.delayed.timing: 4 minute delay Diaphragm to Iliac Crest (Blue box)
quotes.series.delayed.note: Contrast timer on injector will show 4 minutes since the start of the injection
quotes.review_checks: Review non con scan to ensure all of the liver is included.

assumptions.topogram.start_from_landmark_mm: assumed: starts 120 mm above the laser landmark so a 512 mm run covers the default scan box (-80 to 320 mm) with margin; the sheet gives the coverage only in words
assumptions.topogram.length_mm: assumed: 512 mm AP default for abdomen, https://www.aapm.org/pubs/ctprotocols/documents/adultabdomenpelvisct.pdf
assumptions.topogram.kv: assumed: 120 kV from the Siemens dual-topogram example, https://academy.siemens-healthineers.com/_/en-us/syngo-ct-vb10-software-update-care-dose-4d-dual-topogram-job-aid
assumptions.topogram.ma: assumed: 20 mA from the Siemens dual-topogram example, https://academy.siemens-healthineers.com/_/en-us/syngo-ct-vb10-software-update-care-dose-4d-dual-topogram-job-aid
assumptions.contrast.saline_ml: assumed: 40 mL saline chaser (30 to 40 mL for multiphasic liver CT), https://www.aapm.org/pubs/CTProtocols/documents/Adult_Tri-phasic_Liver_HCC_AAPM_format_Clean.pdf
assumptions.contrast.saline_rate_ml_s: assumed: same rate as the contrast, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC5594987/
assumptions.contrast.timing.threshold_hu: https://academy.siemens-healthineers.com/en-us/management-of-scan-and-contrast-media-injection (relative threshold: a rise above baseline, as on CARE Bolus); 100 HU from https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC3265150/. The sheet says only that each scanner has a different HU trigger
assumptions.contrast.timing.monitoring_delay_s: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC8173674 (monitoring starts 10 s after injection start); the sheet gives no value
assumptions.contrast.timing.monitoring_interval_s: https://web.stanford.edu/~dominikf/CT-PROTOCOLS/Stanford_S64-CT-Protocols_version_2.04_DRAFT_small.pdf (1.2 s cycle time); the sheet gives no value
assumptions.contrast.timing.max_monitoring_s: assumed: 60 s maximum monitoring time chosen by the simulator design; no source gives a fallback rule
assumptions.contrast.timing.post_trigger_delay_s: assumed: 15 s from trigger to start of the arterial scan (15 to 30 s late arterial), https://radiopaedia.org/articles/94731
assumptions.contrast.agent: assumed: OMNI 350 on the sheet read as Omnipaque 350 (iohexol); the sheet does not spell it out
assumptions.contrast.concentration_mgi_ml: assumed: 350 mg iodine per mL read from the product name 'OMNI 350'
assumptions.positioning.landmark_fraction_of_height: assumed: landmark about 27 percent of stature below the vertex, near the xiphoid, for the pre-filled estimate; not in the sheet
assumptions.series.noncontrast.default_start_mm: assumed: generous box start 80 mm above the landmark so a stored box covers most patients
assumptions.series.noncontrast.default_end_mm: assumed: generous box end 320 mm below the landmark so a stored box covers most patients
assumptions.series.arterial.default_start_mm: assumed: generous box start 80 mm above the landmark so a stored box covers most patients
assumptions.series.arterial.default_end_mm: assumed: generous box end 320 mm below the landmark so a stored box covers most patients
assumptions.series.venous.default_start_mm: assumed: generous box start 80 mm above the landmark so a stored box covers most patients
assumptions.series.venous.default_end_mm: assumed: generous box end 320 mm below the landmark so a stored box covers most patients
assumptions.series.delayed.default_start_mm: assumed: generous box start 80 mm above the landmark so a stored box covers most patients
assumptions.series.delayed.default_end_mm: assumed: generous box end 320 mm below the landmark so a stored box covers most patients
assumptions.series.arterial.timing: assumed: the arterial scan starts when the trigger fires plus the post-trigger delay; the sheet gives no value
assumptions.scan_defaults.collimation_mm: 96 x 0.6 mm = 57.6 mm z-coverage, https://www.accessdata.fda.gov/cdrh_docs/pdf19/K190578.pdf; assumed here as the default collimation
assumptions.scan_defaults.fov_mm: assumed: 400 mm display field of view for an adult abdomen; the sheet gives none
